g.text: One thread per cell: the thread costs more than the cell
MatrixDemo: (100 x 1000) times (1000 x 100) = 10,000 cells, each a dot product of 1,000 multiply-adds.
Life of one per-cell thread, to scale
create + start + schedule + join about 227 us
Measured: sequential 23 ms, 10,000 threads 2294 ms, same result.
Per cell: 23 ms / 10,000 = 2.3 us of work.
(2294 - 23) ms / 10,000 = about 227 us of thread cost per cell.
The threads spend 99% of the time being threads.
6 chunks, one lane per thread (estimated, 2.3 us per cell)
Gray: the same thread cost, paid 6 times instead of 10,000.
On a 6-core run of the same product: 10,000 threads 1638 ms,
